meta.label: OAE HQ Geo-Informatics Center (ศูนย์สารสนเทศการเกษตร) satellite-derived standing/planted-area-by-amphoe PDFs, mirrored on zone10.oae.go.th, filtered to this zone's provinces
parse_notes: ROUTE: no zone-8/9/12-specific 'ข้อมูลเอกภาพ' district-comparison page (the zone6 pattern: a dedicated zoneN.oae.go.th/ข้อมูลเอกภาพ/ page listing per-crop two-year-comparison PDFs) was found for zone8 (สุราษฎร์ธานี), zone9 (สงขลา), or zone12 (นครสวรรค์) after checking each site's nav menu (incl. nested 'ข้อมูลเศรษฐกิจการเกษตร' / 'งานสารสนเทศการเกษตร' submenus), WordPress ?rest_route=/wp/v2/search and /wp/v2/media search for 'เอกภาพ'/'อำเภอ', wp-sitemap.xml (zone9, zone10 have one; zone8, zone12 do not expose wp-sitemap.xml), direct slug guesses (zoneN.oae.go.th/ข้อมูลเอกภาพ/ and variants), the 'เอกสารเผยแพร่'/'เอกสารดาวน์โหลด'/'ผลงานวิจัย' pages on each site, and Google site: searches. zone9 and zone12's own research/publication pages exist but list different studies (supply-chain, carbon-credit, risk-management), not district crop PDFs. A central hub URL surfaced by web search (oaezone.oae.go.th/view/15|16/ข้อมูลเอกภาพ/TH-TH, which looked like it might be a unified per-zone index) does NOT resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN from this Thai-IP session) - it appears to be a retired/renamed OAE subdomain; not reachable, not used.

WHAT WAS FOUND INSTEAD (zone10 only, then reused for zone8/9/12 by province): zone10.oae.go.th's own 'เอกสารดาวน์โหลด' page (page_id, no cat) links 7 PDFs. Two are zone10-branded single-province coconut standing-area surveys (สศท.10's own ส่วนสารสนเทศการเกษตร, amphoe+tambon detail). The other five (cassava, rubber, oil palm [corrupted, see below], rice นาปรัง, rice นาปี) are NOT zone10-specific - their title pages credit 'ส่วนภูมิสารสนเทศการเกษตร ศูนย์สารสนเทศการเกษตร สำนักงานเศรษฐกิจการเกษตร' (OAE HEADQUARTERS' national Geo-Informatics Center), and each PDF covers ALL of Thailand (Landsat-8/Sentinel-2 remote-sensing standing/planted-area classification, one map+table page per province, grouped by region เหนือ/อีสาน/กลาง/ใต้) - zone10 just happens to host a mirror copy in its own wp-content/uploads. This is a DIFFERENT report FORMAT from zone6's ข้อมูลเอกภาพ (zone6 = a two-recent-years COMPARISON table with planted+harvested+production+yield, sourced from the ต.รต. tambon-level monthly production-condition reporting system; these zone10-hosted files = a SINGLE-YEAR satellite-derived STANDING/PLANTED AREA ONLY classification, no production or yield figures). Because it is genuinely nationwide, the amphoe rows for zone8/9/10/12's own provinces were extracted from these same 4 national PDFs (cassava/rubber/rice-นาปรัง/rice-นาปี) and split into the matching zone shard by province; only zone10 additionally gets its own 2 coconut PDFs.

planted_rai here = the single remote-sensing-derived 'เนื้อที่ยืนต้น'/'เนื้อที่เพาะปลูก' (standing/planted area) figure for the province's crop-year shown in the PDF (cassava/rice: 2567 CE2024; rubber: 2567 CE2024; rice นาปี: 2567/68 CE2024/25; coconut: 2568/2567 per file). harvested_rai, production_tons and yield_kg_per_rai are NOT present in this report type and are left null (unlike zone6's doae_amphoe_crops.json, which has all four from the ต.รต. comparison tables) - this is a genuine schema gap, not a parse failure.

KNOWN GLYPH-CORRUPTION CAVEAT (same font issue flagged for zone6): a subset of these PDFs render the สระอำ (U+0E33) vowel as a bare space + สระอา on extraction, e.g. 'ลำดับ'->'ล าดับ', 'อำเภอ'->'อ าเภอ', 'กำแพงเพชร'->'ก าแพงเพชร'. rubber_2567.pdf is affected badly (province-heading matching needed a space-normalized fallback; some province pages, e.g. เพชรบูรณ์/กาญจนบุรี/ชัยนาท/พัทลุง in the rubber file, still yielded ZERO rows even after that fallback because their table cells themselves came out as one-character-per-line noise - see 'zero_row_pages' below; those province x crop combinations are MISSING from this dataset, not zero-value). amphoe_th values are left RAW/uncorrected as in the zone6 extraction; a fuzzy-match pass against th_amphoe.geojson is needed before any amphoe-join.

สุราษฎร์ธานี (zone8's own seat province) did not surface in ANY of the 4 national crop files despite being a top rubber/coconut/oil-palm producer and appearing in each file's table of contents (e.g. rice_dry_2567.pdf TOC lists '62. จังหวัดสุราษฎร์ธานี 83') - the TOC page-number offset drifts across the document (front matter + variable per-province page counts) enough that this session's page-by-page province-heading scan skipped straight past its table page for reasons not fully diagnosed (possibly a further glyph-corruption variant on that specific province's heading line). Flagged openly rather than fabricated; a follow-up pass should target that PDF's page range directly by printed page number instead of by heading-text match.

oil_palm_2567.pdf (รายงานผลการสำรวจเนื้อที่ยืนต้นปาล์มน้ำมัน ปี 2567) is CORRUPTED on the server: downloaded twice (fresh request, matching Content-Length both times), and both copies end in >200KB of trailing NUL bytes with no PDF trailer/EOF - pdfplumber/pdfminer both fail with 'No /Root object'. Not repairable with the tools available in this session (no qpdf/mutool/pikepdf installed). Saved as-is to source-data/raw/doae-amphoe/zone10/oilpalm_2567.pdf for audit; oil palm is therefore ABSENT from all 4 zone shards even though zone8/9/10 are major oil-palm provinces.
